info.title: Proxy Workbench control API
info.summary: Versioned control API with key management, jobs and events.
info.description: Every route lives under /v1. Keys travel in the Authorization header; a query token is a deprecated read-only compatibility path. Long operations answer 202 with a job id and never hold the request. Mutations require an Idempotency-Key. Errors use stable E_* codes with a recovery action. The default bind is loopback; a remote bind needs keys and TLS or a reverse proxy, and a Bearer token is not encryption.

servers.description: loopback default; a remote bind needs keys and TLS or a supported reverse proxy setup

bearerKey.description: api_key or subscription secret; never a query parameter

x-network-model.default_bind: loopback; every non-loopback bind must set allow_remote_bind and allowed_hosts
x-network-model.remote_bind: a key is required on every route, including /v1/version
x-network-model.tls: ApiConfig(tls_cert=..., tls_key=...) wraps the listener in TLS 1.2+, or run a supported reverse proxy in front and set allowed_hosts to its name
x-network-model.bearer_is_not_encryption: an Authorization header is not a secure channel; use TLS or a reverse proxy for anything that leaves this machine
x-network-model.host_check: loopback binds accept a loopback Host only; other binds accept the names in allowed_hosts
x-network-model.origin_check: a request with an Origin is refused unless it is in allowed_origins; CORS headers are echoed only for origins in cors_origins
x-network-model.key_transport: Authorization: Bearer only; ?token= is a deprecated read-only path
x-network-model.subscription_secret: read-only, no admin, private fields redacted, with expiry and revoke

x-limits.default_rate_limit: requests per window, per identity and route; 429 with Retry-After
x-limits.request_timeout_s: deadline handed to the service layer in Call.deadline_s
